playbook_steps: The attacker mines a transfer of 0.4 ETH to its own stash wallet and keeps the block private.
It pays a merchant the same 0.4 ETH using the SAME nonce (seen only in the mempool).
The withheld block is then published, so the merchant payment can never confirm.

evidence: Funded by 0xd119bdb7...; no other accounts funded by this source within 5m.
High closed-loop circular transfer ratio: 50.0% of transactions are internal.
Candidate account is newborn (0.0 days old).
